title: Happy Fall Basswood Sign
assembly: Design the 'Happy Fall' word art with the two leaf accents, sized to fit the 12x12 in basswood sheet.
Load the black vinyl on the standard grip mat and cut the design with the fine-point tool.
Weed away the excess vinyl, keeping only the letters and leaves.
Lay transfer tape over the weeded design, burnish well, then peel off the paper backing and lift the design.
Cut the basswood sheet to size if needed, then center the transferred design on the wood.
Press the design down firmly onto the basswood, then slowly peel away the transfer tape.
Lean the finished sign on a shelf or prop it against the backsplash.
